app.name: PureSheets
app.description: Enterprise spreadsheet editing for .sheets and portable .sheets.html workbooks.

createEntities.label: Spreadsheet
createEntities.description: Create a new spreadsheet workbook package.

tools.name: fn_workbookBriefing
tools.description: Inspect the open workbook in one call: returns title, version token for expectedVersion, active sheet, selection, named ranges, per-sheet structural metrics (used range, formula/error/validation/comment/chart counts, locked ranges, headers, and computed preview rows), and recent agent log entries. Replaces getSheetsContext + multiple readRange + listSheetChanges round-trips.

sheet.description: Optional sheet name or id to brief. Omit to brief every visible sheet in the workbook.

previewRows.description: Number of leading rows per sheet to preview with computed values (default 5, max 20).

maxPreviewColumns.description: Maximum columns included in each sheet preview row (default 12, max 20).

recentChangesLimit.description: Number of recent agent log entries to include (default 5, max 25).

tools.name: fn_auditWorkbookFormulasAndData
tools.description: Audit formulas, cross-sheet references, validation rules, and data quality across the workbook (or one sheet) in a single pass. Detects formula error values (#DIV/0!, #REF!, #NAME?, #VALUE!, #N/A, #NUM!), broken cross-sheet references, validation rule violations, hardcoded numeric overrides inside formula columns, and numeric strings stored as text.

sheet.description: Optional sheet name or id to audit. Omit to audit every visible sheet in the workbook.

maxFindings.description: Maximum findings returned per category (default 50, max 200).

tools.name: fn_profileSheetData
tools.description: Profile a sheet or A1 range (up to 25,000 cells) deterministically in one call: infers column types, non-empty/blank/distinct counts, exact numeric statistics (min, max, sum, mean, median), top categorical values, and optional grouped rollup by any column without writing helper formulas.

sheet.description: Sheet name or id to profile. Defaults to the active sheet.

range.description: Optional A1 range to profile. Omit to profile the full used range of the sheet.

hasHeader.description: Whether the first row of the range contains column headers (default true).

groupByColumn.description: Optional column letter (e.g. "A") or header name to compute a grouped rollup.

valueColumn.description: Optional numeric column letter or header name to aggregate per group when groupByColumn is set (defaults to the first numeric column).

topValuesLimit.description: Maximum frequent values listed per column (default 5, max 20).

tools.name: fn_buildStructuredSheetTable
tools.description: Create or populate a structured spreadsheet table in one atomic, version-checked operation: optionally creates a new sheet, writes headers, data rows (values or =formulas), an optional auto-SUM summary row, header/column formatting, cell notes, an optional chart, and live row auto-fit, then returns computed readback and fresh version. Supports dryRun: true to validate before writing.

sheet.description: Target sheet name/id, or new sheet name when createSheet is true.

createSheet.description: Create a new sheet before writing (default false; refuses duplicates).

expectedVersion.description: Exact workbook version; required when createSheet is false.

rows.description: 2D row grid (strings, numbers, =formulas, booleans, null; max 400 total cells).

summaryRow.description: Optional total row below rows: { label?, mode?: "auto-sum"|"custom", formulas? }.

styleHeader.description: Style header row bold with fill and border (default true).

columnFormats.description: Per-column formatting by 0-based index, column letter, or header name.

summary.description: One-line summary recorded in the workbook agent log.

tools.name: fn_applyFormulaAndFormatBatch
tools.description: Apply a version-checked batch of cell edits (values/formulas up to 400 cells), multiple range formatting specs, and cell notes on an existing sheet in one atomic transaction, then return computed formula readback, error checks, and the fresh workbook version. Supports dryRun: true for preview.

sheet.description: Explicit target sheet name or id.

summary.description: One-line summary for the workbook agent log.

range.description: Optional A1 bounding range for cellChanges.

cellChanges.description: Up to 400 cell edits ({ cell, value, kind? }).

formats.description: Up to 25 range formatting specs (bold, italic, underline, border, fontSize, textColor, fillColor, align, numberFormat, decimals, wrap, columnWidth, rowHeight).

comments.description: Up to 50 cell notes ({ cell, comment }); empty comment clears.

tools.name: getSheetsContext
tools.description: Return the workbook: title, path, sheets with used ranges, locked ranges, chart counts, the active sheet, and the current selection.

tools.name: readRange
tools.description: Read the populated cells of an A1 range on one sheet: raw value, kind, and computed value for formulas. Omit range to read the sheet's used range. Capped at 500 cells.

tools.name: applyCellChanges
tools.description: Write cell changes to a sheet directly. Every write is recorded in the workbook's agent log with before/after. Pass the sheet, the range the work covers, the cell changes, and a one-line summary — it is the line the user reads in the log. Requires an explicit sheet, target range and current expectedVersion from readRange/getSheetsContext. All changed cells must lie in the target range; stale workbook proposals are rejected. Call completeWorkbook after changes for saved artifact evidence.

cellChanges.description: The cells to write: A1 key, value (raw text or formula source), and kind. Formulas are kind 'formula' with the leading =. Locked cells are skipped, never mutated.

expectedVersion.description: Exact workbook version returned by getSheetsContext/readRange. Read again after any mutation.

tools.name: completeWorkbook
tools.description: Save the current workbook, verify its saved content, and return its durable deliverable receipt. Required after all requested writes before completing a mission. Use the returned workbook paths in the final result, never an upstream source path. Retry after a reported save or concurrent-change error; do not claim completion on error.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PureSheets's extended specialist tools (13 tools across annotations, charts, formatting, reference, search, sheets, workbook) and composite functions (5 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "annotations", "charts", "formatting", "reference", "search").

category.description: Optional category filter (annotations, charts, formatting, reference, search, sheets, workbook, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PureSheets's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: annotations, charts, formatting, reference, search, sheets, workbook). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PureSheets's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: annotations, charts, formatting, reference, search, sheets, workbook). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
